home.subtitle: Resource Hub · Collect, organize & share
home.introText: This is Zelm's personal resource library and portfolio. I gradually collect, organize and distill the websites, dev tools, study materials and data-analysis works I use day to day — a personal index for myself, and hopefully a help to you passing by. The site is built end-to-end by me (Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Vue), and keeps growing with my learning. Pick things up slowly, and grow together.

privacy.pageIntro: This site is a personal portfolio for learning and tech exchange. The following explains how we handle your information and the rules you agree to when using the site.
privacy.p1a: Account information: the username and password you provide at sign-up. Passwords are stored as PBKDF2 salted hashes — we never store, nor can we see, your plaintext password.
privacy.p1b: Security information: the IP address at login and request time, used only for risk control and rate limiting (to prevent brute-force and abuse), retained briefly then purged automatically.
privacy.p1c: Community content: the messages, replies and likes you post.
privacy.p1d: Local preferences: theme, language, layout and similar settings are saved in your own browser's localStorage and never uploaded to our servers.
privacy.p2Body: Only to: identify your login, provide community features like messages and feedback, and keep accounts and the service secure. We will not sell or share your personal information with third parties for marketing.
privacy.p3a: Passwords are stored with an irreversible salted hash algorithm.
privacy.p3b: Login credentials (JWT) are stored in HttpOnly + Secure + SameSite=Strict cookies, unreadable by frontend scripts and sent only over HTTPS.
privacy.p3c: Data is stored in a Cloudflare D1 database (overseas nodes).
privacy.p4Body: We only use essential cookies: login credentials, site configuration and language/theme preferences. No advertising or third-party tracking cookies.
privacy.p5Body: You can change your username and password yourself. To close your account and delete all personal information, contact us via the email at the end; after verifying your identity we will delete your account and related content.
privacy.p6Body: This site is not intended for children under 14. If you are a minor, please use it with a guardian. If we accidentally collect a child's personal information, contact us to have it removed.
privacy.p7Body: This policy may change as features evolve; updates are posted on this page, and continued use means you accept the updated policy.
privacy.t1Body: This site is a personal portfolio for learning and tech exchange. It is non-commercial and offers no paid membership or commercial services.
privacy.t2Body: Please keep your account and password safe. You are responsible for any consequences of a leak caused by your own actions. If anything looks wrong, change your password immediately.
privacy.t3Intro: When posting in the guestbook, feedback and similar features, you may not post:
privacy.t3a: content that violates the laws and regulations of the People's Republic of China;
privacy.t3b: content that infringes others' copyright, trademark, privacy or other lawful rights;
privacy.t3c: harassment, defamation, insults toward others, or discriminatory speech;
privacy.t3d: advertising, spam, malicious links or programs;
privacy.t3e: any other content that disrupts the normal order of the site.
privacy.t4Body: For content or accounts that break these rules, we may delete content, limit features, or freeze or close the account without further notice.
privacy.t5Body: The copyright of what you post belongs to you, but you grant the site the rights needed to display and share it. The site's own UI, code and original content belong to the site; third-party material compiled and cited here belongs to its original authors.
privacy.t6Body: The site is provided "as is", without guarantee of uninterrupted or error-free service. We are not liable for losses caused by force majeure such as network or device failures.
privacy.crIntro: If you believe content on this site infringes your lawful rights, contact us via the email below. Once we receive a valid notice, we will remove the content or disable the link after verification.
privacy.crEmailHint: To help us act quickly, please include in your email: proof of your identity, proof of rights, the URL of the suspected infringing content, your contact details, and a statement that the information is true and accurate.
